analyst_view.overall: Early view: two struggling sides with new coaches. Alanyaspor lost four league games in a row and parted with Joao Pereira; Ugur Ucar, who took Corum up last season, was appointed on 10-11 November. Samsunspor sit 17th but won their last game under Nenad Bjelica, who replaced Thorsten Fink in mid-October.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean lower: both teams are short of confidence near the bottom, and a fresh coach at Alanyaspor plus Bjelica's stated aim of rebuilding Samsunspor's confidence point to a tight, nervy game where neither side wants to lose.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. Alanyaspor at home should have more of the ball, but there is no clear news on how Ucar will set them up, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. This is a game between two teams in the bottom half fighting for points, which tends to bring more fouls and bookings; I lean slightly higher, pending the referee.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.2 shots. Alanyaspor under a new coach may push hard at home to make a first impression, but Samsunspor have been shaky, so the overall figure looks about right.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.6 shots on target. Teams on long losing runs, like Alanyaspor with four straight defeats, often shoot from poor positions, so I lean a little lower on accuracy.
